notebooks.title: Introduction & Environment Setup in PyTorch
notebooks.description: Hands-on setup with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and basic neural tensor operations.

notebooks.title: Word Representations, Word2Vec & Text Classification
notebooks.description: Implementing word vector embeddings, continuous representations, and sentiment classification.

notebooks.title: Autoregressive Neural Language Modeling Fundamentals
notebooks.description: Building next-token prediction language models from scratch with Cross-Entropy Loss.

notebooks.title: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN & LSTM) in PyTorch
notebooks.description: Implementing recurrent sequence encoders, LSTM cells, and gated hidden state transitions.

notebooks.title: Transformer Architecture & Scaled Dot-Product Attention
notebooks.description: Modular implementation of Multi-Head Self-Attention, Positional Encoding, and Feed-Forward blocks.

notebooks.title: LLM Pretraining Pipelines & Data Preprocessing at Scale
notebooks.description: Web text scraping, quality filtering, deduplication pipelines, and batch sequence packing.

notebooks.title: In-Context Learning (ICL) & Few-Shot Prompt Engineering
notebooks.description: Demonstrating few-shot learning, prompt calibration, and instruction formatting across open LLMs.

notebooks.title: Instruction Fine-Tuning & Parameter-Efficient LoRA Adaptation
notebooks.description: Fine-tuning foundation models with LoRA/QLoRA using Hugging Face PEFT and TRL.

notebooks.title: Decoding Algorithms, Sampling (Top-p/Top-k) & Search
notebooks.description: Greedy decoding, temperature scaling, top-k/nucleus sampling, and beam search implementations.

notebooks.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Vector Indexing
notebooks.description: Dense passage retrieval (DPR), vector database indexing with FAISS, chunking, and generation.

notebooks.title: Multimodal Vision-Language Models (CLIP & Visual Embeddings)
notebooks.description: Contrastive image-text training (CLIP), zero-shot visual classification, and multimodal alignment.

notebooks.title: Multimodal Instruction Tuning & Visual Generation (LLaVA)
notebooks.description: Cross-modal projection, Visual Question Answering (VQA), and multimodal chat assistants.

notebooks.title: LLM Evaluation Benchmarks & Automated Scoring Metrics
notebooks.description: Benchmarking with MMLU and GSM8K, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations, and statistical confidence intervals.

notebooks.title: Research Skills, Experimental Design & Ablation Analysis
notebooks.description: Designing rigorous NLP ablation experiments, statistical significance testing, and artifact analysis.

notebooks.title: Diffusion Models & Flow Matching for Text Generation
notebooks.description: Implementing continuous/discrete text diffusion models, denoising steps, and flow matching.

notebooks.title: Reinforcement Learning Fundamentals & Policy Optimization (PPO)
notebooks.description: Markov Decision Processes, policy gradients, advantage estimation, and Proximal Policy Optimization.

notebooks.title: Preference Alignment for LLMs (RLHF & Direct Preference Optimization / DPO)
notebooks.description: Bradley-Terry reward modeling, RLHF with PPO, and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

notebooks.title: LLM-Based Autonomous Agents, Function Calling & Tool Use (ReAct)
notebooks.description: Building autonomous agent loops with ReAct prompting, API tool integration, and environment feedback.

notebooks.title: Model Quantization (AWQ, GPTQ & INT8/INT4 Precision)
notebooks.description: Weight quantization with bitsandbytes, activation-aware quantization (AWQ), and inference benchmarking.

notebooks.title: Distributed Training, Model Parallelism & ZeRO Optimization
notebooks.description: Tensor and pipeline parallelism (Megatron-LM), ZeRO memory stages (DeepSpeed), and FSDP on GPU clusters.

datasets.name: MMLU (Massive Multitask Language Understanding)
datasets.description: 57 subjects across STEM, humanities, and social sciences for holistic LLM benchmarking.

datasets.name: GSM8K (Grade School Math 8K)
datasets.description: 8,500 high-quality multi-step math reasoning word problems for Chain-of-Thought evaluation.

datasets.name: UltraFeedback & Anthropic HH-RLHF
datasets.description: Binarized pairwise human preference datasets for RLHF and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

datasets.name: MS MARCO & HotpotQA
datasets.description: Passage ranking and multi-hop reasoning datasets for open-domain RAG benchmarking.
